# pve_sdn_rollback (Action)

Rolls back the pending SDN configuration to the last applied state (`POST /cluster/sdn/rollback`). Warning: this discards *every* pending SDN change cluster-wide, including changes made outside Terraform; applied configuration is not touched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Discard every pending SDN change cluster-wide, restoring the last applied
# configuration. Already applied configuration is not touched.
action "pve_sdn_rollback" "discard_pending" {}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `lock_token` (String) Global SDN configuration lock token; when provided the rollback runs under this lock.
- `release_lock` (Boolean) Release the lock supplied in `lock_token` automatically after a successful rollback. PVE defaults this to `true`.
